about_the_game:
ULTIMATE AUTO-RPG: THE STALKER adds 1 new playable class "The Stalker" with a unique set of skills and 2 new playable races to the game. By buying this DLC you are first and foremost showing your support for Ultimate Auto-RPG and future development but you also get a load of exclusive bonus content.

PLAYABLE CLASS

  • Assassin
  • Stalker (Subclass)

PLAYABLE RACES

  • Gokron
  • Noggin

NOGGIN
The Noggin was an ancient tribe that lived in treehouses in a forest between desert southlands and the zulmaris swamplands. In the first age an ancient evil called Culzhargg from the depths of the ocean invaded the forest and placed a powerful curse on the Noggin. This curse would prevent any Noggin from fishing in the waters close to their village. It was a disaster for the tribe. They would starve to death without their fishing. The elder shaman Mukzorg, the oldest of all the Noggin was sent out to get help. In a tavern called Driftwood in Stormholme he found the blue wizard Leonardo and his companion priestess Sora. Leonardo agreed to form a fellowship with the quest to defeat the ancient evil and help the Noggin.

GOKRON
In the third age the Manheim Trading Company that controls most of the trade routes in the human kingdoms encountered a mysterious merchant race called the Gokron. First contact was made when a caravan was sent out from the Gokron settlement of Loktororr in the desert southlands to travel all the way to the human capital of Stormholme and trade priceless artifacts found deep within the dwarven mines in the Glimmerpass mountains. The gokrons used ancient hidden pathways deep within the mountains for all their trading routes between the humans, elves and the dwarven kingdoms. The wizards of the tower always knew that the gokrons could not be trusted since they worshipped the Void Demon Molgor also known as the nightshade.
